title: Acknowledge historical PR incident attention in Companion
description: Use a stopped, unacknowledged validation monitor produced by e2e-pr-rule-actions.mts. Set PR_PUSH_ATTENTION_ID to the same monitor:<monitor-id>:<incident-id> as attention_id. No push credentials are required for in-app attention.

open.cmd: if [ "$PLATFORM" = ios ]; then xcrun simctl openurl "$IOS_SIMULATOR" "farmslot-development:///pr-automation?attentionId=$PR_PUSH_ATTENTION_ID"; else adb -s "$ANDROID_SERIAL" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "farmslot-development:///pr-automation?attentionId=$PR_PUSH_ATTENTION_ID" net.siteed.farmslot.development; fi
open.intent: An incident link opens its current recipient-scoped record even when the subscription has stopped.

ready.intent: The historical conflict is still readable from the shared gateway history.

visible.intent: The acknowledgement control is reachable below the notification delivery settings.

evidence.intent: The screenshot records the historical conflict and its available acknowledgement action.

acknowledge.intent: The operator acknowledges their notification independently of GitHub resolution or repair.

verify.intent: A separate gateway connection confirms acknowledgement while preserving the unresolved conflict, stopped subscription and zero repair attempts.
